neighbours.label: the American Midwest as a place: its states, towns, colleges and farm country (Iowa, Indiana, Nebraska, Illinois, Des Moines, the Hoosiers, 'the Midwest'), named or not; also the word 'Indiana' in other senses. Places in the South, New England and the West Coast stay low
fire: After college he took a reporting job at a small paper in Nebraska.
The caucus crowds filled a gymnasium in Cedar Rapids on a snowy night.
Purdue's marching band played before the kickoff in West Lafayette.
Tornado sirens wailed across the cornfields outside Ames.
Most of my cousins still farm soybeans near Lincoln.
Like many people raised in the Midwest, she says 'pop' instead of 'soda'.
The Illinois state fair opened in Springfield with a butter cow.
A rescued greyhound named Indiana now sleeps on our couch.
quiet: After college he took a reporting job at a small paper in Vermont.
The rally crowds filled a gymnasium in Charleston on a humid night.
Clemson's marching band played before the kickoff in Death Valley.
Hurricane sirens wailed across the marshes outside Galveston.
Most of my cousins still grow peaches near Macon.
Like many people raised in New England, she says 'wicked' instead of 'very'.
The Oregon state fair opened in Salem with a quilt show.
A rescued greyhound named Georgia now sleeps on our couch.

notes: Found by the world-atlas tier-1 census (64 US states, DC and Canadian provinces/territories, 8 pairs each: 4 named, 4 described without the name; controls swap in a neighbouring or distant place; discovery only). Under a contrast rule it was a candidate in 9 places: Indiana 0.81, Illinois 0.74, Iowa 0.69, Nebraska 0.65, Missouri 0.49, South Dakota 0.47, Wisconsin 0.46, Kansas 0.45, Manitoba 0.40 (mean over 8 passages). Card: max 53, density 0.40%; peaks ' Indiana' x9, ' Iowa' x8, ' Midwest' x2. Triage probes (exploratory, none reused): Des Moines farm fields 0.72, the Hoosiers in Bloomington 0.82, 'the Midwest' 0.71, Iowa 0.75, 'Indiana Jones' 0.75 (so the word leaks: claimed), southern Manitoba 0.48 (not claimed or tested), Atlanta 0.16, Maryland 0.05.
